descriptions.w3d_fn_8018573c: Returns 0; likely a default virtual method of XParticleSetInstance.
descriptions.w3d_pset_instance_owner_flags: Returns the first flag byte reported by the particle-set instance's owner.
descriptions.w3d_pset_instance_shutdown: Runs base shutdown, detaches the particle-set instance from its owner and releases its emitter.
descriptions.w3d_node_construct: Constructs a scene node: clears children, resets ids, zero/one vectors, copies the identity transform.
descriptions.w3d_node_destruct: Destroys a scene node: releases its attachment and child storage, and frees it when asked.
descriptions.w3d_node_add_ref: Increments the node's 15-bit reference count and returns the new value.
descriptions.w3d_node_release: Decrements the node's reference count and destroys it through its vtable when it reaches zero.
descriptions.w3d_node_query_interface: Clears the output and reports that no extra interface is supported.
descriptions.w3d_node_reset: Detaches the node from its parent, removes all children and resets its three vectors.
descriptions.w3d_node_set_type: Stores a type byte and returns the not-implemented status.
descriptions.w3d_node_not_implemented: Returns the not-implemented status; a default virtual method.
descriptions.w3d_node_in_use: Returns 1 when the node has any references, otherwise 0.
descriptions.w3d_node_set_id: Sets the node's 16-bit id and returns success.
descriptions.w3d_node_set_mode: Changes the node's mode byte and reapplies it through virtual methods when it differs.
